fullPassage: With millions of members in a colony, leaf-cutter ants cultivate their own food. Just like humans, they’re farmers. Some of the ants set forth from the nest to find fresh vegetation; when they find it, they chew off large pieces that they carry back to the nest. However, the ants don’t eat these leaves. Instead, smaller worker ants take the pieces of leaves, chew them into smaller pieces, and use these as fertilizer to grow fungus in large underground ‘gardens.’ The ants feed the fungus, and the fungus blossoms into small fruiting bodies which the ants later eat. Using this successful farming strategy, the ants build enormous nests underground, something spanning hundreds of square meters. Just like humans, they have perfected an agricultural civilization.

questions.passage: With millions of members in a colony, leaf-cutter ants cultivate their own food. Just like humans, they’re farmers. Some of the ants set forth from the nest to find fresh vegetation; when they find it, they chew off large pieces that they carry back to the nest. However, the ants don’t eat these leaves. Instead, smaller worker ants take the pieces of leaves, chew them into smaller pieces, and use these as fertilizer to grow fungus in large underground ‘gardens.’ The ants feed the fungus, and the fungus blossoms into small fruiting bodies which the ants later eat. Using this successful farming strategy, the ants build enormous nests underground, something spanning hundreds of square meters. Just like humans, they have perfected an agricultural civilization.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글 전체는 가위개미가 인간처럼 먹이를 재배해 농업 문명을 이룬 '농부'라는 점을 말한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 인간처럼 잎을 길러 농업 문명을 이룬 농부 — 글 전체 요지 ← 정답
❌ ② 개미는 잎을 직접 먹지 않음
❌ ③ 개미가 균류를 길러 줌(feed the fungus)
❌ ④ 인간 농장과의 크기 비교는 언급 없음
det.tip: they’re farmers + perfected an agricultural civilization

ch: 가위개미는 인간처럼 잎을 길러 농업 문명을 이룬 농부다.
가위개미는 신선한 잎만 골라 먹으며 살아간다.
균류는 개미의 도움 없이 스스로 자라 번식한다.
개미의 집은 인간의 농장보다 훨씬 규모가 크다.
